notes.title: v0.2.0.4
notes.content:
The following bugs were fixed
- Opening the pause menu while in the Skins Shop softlocks player
- Strawberries still appear on loaded saves that have completed the activity
- Players can accidentally trigger blueberry feeding twice, causing players to lose multiple blueberries
- Minimizing the Main Menu causes controls to lose focus on application
